'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Hayes Hunter DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Hayes Hunter]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
